                                                                       How Do You Apply?
                                         Applications may be requested in person or by mailing a self-addressed envelope to:

                                                                                             Apex Place Apartments
                                                                                      257 PARK AVENUE SOUTH, 12TH FLOOR,
                                                                                              NEW YORK, NY 10010

                                  Applications may also be requested by emailing Rentals@phippsny.org or by calling 646.388.8227

                                                                                  What Happens After You Submit an Application?

 Applications are logged in the order in which they are received. Applicants who appear to qualify will be contacted to submit documents that verify their household
                                                  size, identity of members of the household and household income.
